FAQ

Q: Do skincare fridges really work?

Yes. Scientific studies confirm that cooler temperatures slow the degradation of active ingredients like vitamin C and retinol. A skincare fridge kept at 36-46°F can extend product shelf life by 2-3x compared to room temperature storage.

Q: What temperature should a skincare fridge be set to?

We recommend setting your skincare fridge between 36-46°F (2-8°C). This range preserves active ingredients without freezing water-based products. Avoid temperatures below 32°F as they can damage emulsions and serums.

Q: Can I store makeup in a skincare fridge?

Absolutely. Most skincare fridges are perfect for storing foundation, concealer, mascara, and eye creams. The cool temperature helps preserve pigments and prevent bacterial growth in cosmetic products.
